headline: The first signed release: download it, drag it to Applications, and it keeps itself up to date.

items.title: Notarized by Apple
items.detail: One universal app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs, which macOS opens without any workaround.

items.title: Automatic updates
items.detail: Everest checks once a day and installs when you choose Restart to Update. It never touches the keyboard's firmware.

items.title: A new icon
items.detail: Everest now has its own icon and pictures.

items.title: After upgrading
items.detail: macOS sees a new app once: grant Accessibility and Full Disk Access again if you use them.
